slug: 2025-12-15 Loi n 195-AN-25 portant creation de l'Autorite Nationale de Cybersecurite (Djibouti, JO)

facts.fact: Law 195/AN/25/9eme L, published in the Journal Officiel on 15 December 2025 after National Assembly adoption on 12 November 2025, creates the Autorite Nationale de Cybersecurite (ANC) as a public administrative body attached to the Presidency, with a national CERT among its tasks.

systems.owner: Presidency of the Republic, supervised by the Direction Generale de la Securite Nationale
